name: niche-mainstream
title: Niche: mainstream retailers
description: Google Shopping results from stores in Niche's retailer bank, labelled by store and type. Sponsored results and unknown stores are dropped.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: 1 to 3 search phrases, e.g. from Claude's query planner.

maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)
maxPrice.description: Items above this price are dropped.

itemsPerQuery.title: Items per query
itemsPerQuery.description: How many results to read per search phrase (per marketplace for secondhand).

tiers.title: Store types
tiers.description: Optional: department, mainstream, athletic, outdoor, premium, luxury, fast_fashion, off_price, big_box, marketplace, resale.

includeUnlisted.title: Include stores outside the bank
includeUnlisted.description: Keep results from stores that are not in the retailer bank, labelled as small shops.

maxConcurrentRuns.title: Max scraper runs at once
maxConcurrentRuns.description: Sub-scraper runs this actor starts at the same time. Apify's free plan allows 5 runs account-wide, including this one.
